client_phase_sampling.method: ps process-tree samples every 250 ms during client load/queries only
client_phase_sampling.cpu_note: Sum of maximum observed lifetime CPU TIME per PID, including startup CPU; a lower bound because short-lived processes and work after the final sample may be missed. TIME has OS-specific precision.
client_phase_sampling.rss_note: Sum of per-process resident pages double-counts shared PostgreSQL pages; this is neither unique physical memory nor a hard memory budget.
